note: Stage 1d closing sentences (design 04_段階1d, 2026-10-23). Each set has 12 sentences; sentence k of every set has the same word count as neutral_C[k]. anger_L/fear_L = Stage 1c sets with k=6 lengthened by one word to fix the word-count mismatch found by R2. joy_L = one positive emotion word. eval_L = negative moral evaluation of the event, no word from the forbidden emotion list E. neutral_C unchanged from Stage 1c.
anger_L: I was really mad about it.
I was seething for the whole evening.
It made me angry all day.
I could not hide my anger.
fear_L: I was really afraid of it.
I was scared for the whole evening.
It made me afraid all day.
I could not hide my fear.
joy_L: I was really glad about it.
I was cheerful for the whole evening.
It made me happy all day.
I could not hide my joy.
eval_L: It was really unfair to me.
I considered it wrong the whole evening.
It seemed unjust to everyone there.
I could not excuse such behavior.
neutral_C: I wrote it down on paper.
I stayed in town the whole evening.
It rained in town all day.
I checked the time again later.
